Title: Large storage for Azure Database for MySQL now in preivew

Body.Content:
We are excited to announce support for up to 16TB of storage and up to 20,000 IOPS in Azure Database for MySQL. With this preview, we are not only providing five times more storage for your database servers, but also more than triple the available IOPS. This ensures that you can run your most demanding, large scale workloads on Azure Database for MySQL.

Learn more in the related Azure Database for MySQL documentation.
